Name: MOVEMENT_AC_TYPE_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the movement parameters based on AC type.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Jump: Maximum Horizontal Speed
Fields.Description: The maximum horizontal speed when performing a jump. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Jump: Horizontal Acceleration
Fields.Description: The horizontal acceleration when performing a jump. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: Jump: Maximum Vertical Speed
